public.hero.title: Xiyimo xa swimilwa xi hlayiwa hi maxelo lama hundzeke
public.hero.intro: Mecropolis yi hlanganisa masiku ya ku hisa lama pfunaka swimilwa ku kula, hi mahiselo lama rhekhodiweke hi Open-Meteo ku sukela loko swi byariwile. Yi yisa nguva yin'wana ni yin'wana ya Kapa Vupeladyambu eka xiyimo lexi landzelaka loko ntsengo wu hundza mpimo wa ximila.

public.how.title: Ku suka eka siku ro byala ku ya eka xiyimo
public.how.lead: Xiyimo xi tala ku nghenisiwa hi voko, kutani xi va xa nkarhi wa ku pfuxeta ko hetelela ntsena. Laha xi hlayiwa hi maxelo lama rhekhodiweke, naswona ku cinca kun'wana ni kun'wana ku hlayisa vumbhoni bya kona.
public.step.1.title: Rhekhoda leswi murimi a swi tivaka
public.step.1.body: Mapurasi, masimu, swimilwa ni masiku yo byala swi hlayisiwa eka Sanity.
public.step.2.title: Teka maxelo lama hundzeke
public.step.2.body: Mahiselo ya siku ni siku ya ndhawu ya nsimu ma huma eka rhekhodo ya Open-Meteo, ku sukela loko ku byariwile ku fika namuntlha.
public.step.3.title: Hlanganisa masiku ya ku hisa
public.step.3.body: Masiku ya ku hisa lama pfunaka swimilwa ku kula (GDD) ma hlanganisiwa hi modele wa ximila. Loko mpimo wu hundziwa, sisiteme yi yisa nguva eka xiyimo lexi landzelaka kutani yi rhekhoda xivangelo.

public.models.lead: Masiku ya ku hisa lama lavekaka leswaku ximila xi vupfa. Tipharamitha leti ti tsariwe hi voko naswona a ti si va na swihlovo.

public.yields.title: Mimpimo ya ntshovelo leyi kandziyisiweke

public.honesty.1.body: Loko mutirhisi a nga si tsala ntshovelo, app yi komba “A swi tsariwanga”.
public.honesty.2.title: Swipimelo i tirhekhodo leti hambaneke
public.honesty.2.body: Tinhlayo ta xifundzha ni ta tiko ti hlayisiwa eka matsalwa ya tona, swin'we ni xihlovo ni yuniti. A ti pimanisiwi ni ntshovelo wa nsimu.
public.honesty.3.title: Tirhekhodo ta switsotswana i ta xifundzha
public.honesty.3.body: Tirhekhodo ta GBIF ti komba laha swi voniweke kona eka 100 km, ni mpfhuka wa kona.
public.honesty.4.title: Maxelo i ya nkarhi wa sweswi
public.honesty.4.body: Mahiselo ma tekiwa eka vuhlayiselo bya Open-Meteo loko ma komberiwa.

public.about.title: Hi Mecropolis
public.about.heading: Hi Mecropolis
public.about.lead: Mecropolis i xilandzeleri xa masimu ni swimilwa xa purasi ra Western Cape.
public.about.why.title: Hikwalahokayini yi ri kona
public.about.why.body: Swiyimo swa nsimu swa hundzeriwa hi nkarhi, naswona ntshovelo wu tsariwa hi ku tsundzuka. Mecropolis yi hlayela xiyimo hi maxelo lama rhekhodiweke. Nhlayo yin'wana ni yin'wana yi huma eka mutirhisi kumbe eka xihlovo xa mani na mani lexi boxiweke.
public.about.design.title: Ndlela leyi yi endliweke ha yona
public.about.design.1.body: Masiku ya ku kula hi ku hisa ma hlengeletiwa ku sukela siku ro byala hi vuhlayiselo bya Open-Meteo. Ku cinca kun'wana ni kun'wana ka xiyimo ku hlayisa vumbhoni bya kona: siku leri ku sunguleke ha rona, ntsengo wa GDD ni leswi wu hlayiweke hi swona.
public.about.design.2.body: Xiyimo lexi landzelaka xa ku nga si tshovela xi vuriwa ku vupfa hi ku hisa hikuva a ku na xiendlakalo xa ntshovelo lexi rhekhodiweke.
public.about.design.4.body: Swi hlayisiwa eka matsalwa ya swona, swin'we ni xihlovo, yuniti ni layisense.
public.about.stack.title: Thekinoloji leyi tirhisiwaka
public.about.stack.body: I app ya pheji yin'we ya Vite na React 19 eka Cloudflare Pages. Browser yi hlaya data ya mani na mani ya Sanity hi ku kongoma hi GROQ ni muyingiseri wa nkarhi wa sweswi. Ku tsala ni data leyi lavaka khiyi swi hundza eka Cloudflare Pages Functions, leyi kambelaka cookie ya session leyi sayiniweke. Zod yi kambela laha data yi nghenaka ni ku huma kona, Vitest yi endla swikambelo, kasi Tailwind 4 yi khavisa.
public.about.limits.title: Swipimelo leswi tivekaka
public.about.limits.1: Tipharamitha ta modele wa swimilwa (mahiselo ya le hansi, nkarhi wa ku hisa ku fikela ku mila ni ku vupfa) ti tsariwe hi voko naswona a ti si va ni swihlovo.
public.about.limits.2: Xipimelo xa lupin xi huma eka HarvestStat xa 2000 ku ya eka 2007 ntsena, naswona ku nghenisiwa ka data ko sungula a ku kumanga matsalwa ya xipimelo xa lupin.
public.about.limits.3: Data ya switsotswana i tirhekhodo ta GBIF ta le kusuhi ni purasi. Ti komba laha muxaka wu rhekhodiweke kona ekusuhi ni purasi.
public.about.limits.4: Demo yi ni ndlela yin'we yo nghena leyi tirhisiwaka hi vanhu vo tala ni xipimelo xa swikombelo lexi hlayisiwaka emiehleketweni ya sisiteme. Ku nghena ku tumbeta tipheji ta dashboard kambe a ku sirheleli data: data yi hlayiwa hi mani na mani. Kambe ku sirhelela ku tsala hinkwako.

docs.stages.title: Ndlela leyi swiyimo swi landzelelanaka ha yona
docs.stages.intro: Tinguva ti ya mahlweni hi swiyimo swa tsevu:
docs.stages.guards: Ku ya eka xiyimo xin'wana ni xin'wana ku ni swilaveko. Ku byariwa ku lava siku ro byala ni ximila; ku kula ku lava mpimo wa masiku ya ku hisa wo mila; ku nga si tshovela ku lava 90% ya mpimo wo vupfa; ku vupfa hi ku hisa ku lava ku fika eka mpimo wo vupfa; ku kambela ku lava xifaniso xa maxelo ya nguva ni xipimelo lexi tiyisisiweke. Swilaveko swa GDD swi tlhela swi lava data ya mahiselo ya kwalomu ka 90% ya nkarhi, naswona ku ya eka xiyimo lexi siku ra xona ri nga enkarhini lowu taka swa siveriwa.

guide.title: Ndlela yo tirhisa Mecropolis
guide.lead: Xiletelo xo koma hi marito yo olova. Xi hlamusela leswi app yi endleriweke swona, lava yi endleriweke vona ni leswi xiphemu xin’wana ni xin’wana xi swi endleka.
guide.what.title: Mecropolis i yini
guide.what.p1: Mecropolis i app yo landzelela masimu ni swimilana epurasini. Yi hlanganisa ku kufumela loku ximilana xi ku kumeke ku sukela loko xi byariwile leswaku yi vona laha xi fikeke kona. Yi tlhela yi ku komba maxelo, misava ni switsotswana swa le kusuhi ni purasi ra wena endhawini yin’we.
guide.what.p2: Yi endleriwe mapurasi ya Western Cape eAfrika-Dzonga, kambe ndlela leyi yi tirha eka purasi rin’wana ni rin’wana, muganga wun’wana ni wun’wana ni nguva yin’wana ni yin’wana.
guide.who.title: Yi endleriwe mani
guide.who.p1: Yi endleriwe munhu loyi a langutelaka masimu, ku fana ni murimi, mufambisi wa purasi kumbe mutsundzuxi wa vona.
guide.who.p2: A swi lavi leswaku u tiva tikhompyuta kumbe sayense ya maxelo. Loko u kota ku pfula webusayiti, u nga tirhisa Mecropolis.
guide.why.title: Hikwalahokayini u nga yi tirhisa
guide.why.1: U nga hatla u vona swimilana leswi swa ha ku byariwaka, leswi kulaka ni leswi nga kusuhi ni ku tshoveriwa.
guide.why.2: A swi lavi leswaku u pfuxeta nsimu yin’wana ni yin’wana hi voko, hikuva app yi yisa ximilana xin’wana ni xin’wana eka xiyimo lexi landzelaka loko maxelo ma komba leswaku nkarhi wu fikile.
guide.why.3: Yi ku lemukisa hi xirhami ni ku hisa ka masiku lama taka, ni hi switsotswana leswi voniweke ekusuhi ni purasi ra wena.
guide.why.4: Hinkwako leswi tsariweke hi nsimu, ku fana ni ku fafazela, xitsotswana lexi u xi voneke kumbe xitsundzuxo, swi hlayisiwa endhawini yin’we ni siku ra swona leswaku u ta swi languta endzhaku.
guide.why.5: Nomboro yin’wana ni yin’wana yi komba laha yi humaka kona, leswaku u tiva leswi u nga swi tshembaka.
guide.heat.title: Ndlela leyi app yi tivaka laha ximilana xi fikeke kona
guide.heat.p1: Swimilana swi kula hi ku hatlisa loko ku kufumela, swi nonoka loko ku titimela. Mecropolis yi hlayela ku kufumela loku siku ni siku hi tiyuniti ta ku hisa, leti vativi va ti vitanaka growing degree days kumbe GDD.
guide.heat.p2: Siku ni siku yi teka mpimo wa le xikarhini ka mahiselo ya le henhla ni ya le hansi, kutani yi susa mahiselo lawa ximilana xi tshikaka ku kula eka wona. Lawa ma salaka i tiyuniti ta ku hisa ta siku rero. Siku ro titimela a ri engeteli na xin’we.
guide.heat.p3: Ximilana xin’wana ni xin’wana xi lava ntsengo wo karhi wa tiyuniti ta ku hisa xi nga si lunghekela ku tshoveriwa. Loko ntsengo wa ku sukela eku byariweni wu tshinela eka nomboro yoleyo, ximilana xi ya eka xiyimo lexi landzelaka.
guide.heat.p4: Mahiselo ma huma eka Open-Meteo, vukorhokeri bya mahala bya maxelo byi rhekhodaka maxelo ya tindhawu hinkwato ta misava.
guide.stages.title: Swiyimo swa tsevu
guide.stages.intro: Ximilana xin’wana ni xin’wana ensin'wini yin’wana ni yin’wana xi hundza eka swiyimo leswi hi ku landzelelana loku.
guide.stages.planning: Nguva yi lulamisiwile, kambe ximilana a xi si byariwa.
guide.stages.growing: Ximilana xi hlengeleta tiyuniti ta ku hisa.
guide.stages.preHarvest: Ximilana xi hlengelete ku hisa ko tala loku xi ku lavaka, kutani i nkarhi wo lunghiselela ntshovelo.
guide.stages.harvested: Ximilana xi hlengelete ku hisa hinkwako loku xi ku lavaka, kutani xi fanele xi lunghekile. Hi wena ntsena u nga vulaka loko xi tshoveriwile hakunene, kutani app yi vula leswaku xi vupfile hi ku ya hi mahiselo.
guide.stages.review: Nguva yi herile naswona u nga languta ndlela leyi yi fambeke ha yona.
guide.stages.p2: App yi kambela ximilana xin’wana ni xin’wana vusiku byin’wana ni byin’wana, ni nkarhi wun’wana ni wun’wana loko munhu a nghenisa leswi a swi voneke kumbe leswi a swi endleke ensin'wini. U nga tlhela u tshikelela Kambela sweswi eka nguva leswaku yi kambela hi nkarhi wolowo.
guide.start.title: Ku sungula
guide.start.1: Pfula tluka ro sungula. U nga vona mepe wa maxelo, misava, switsotswana ni ntshovelo swa purasi ra xikombiso u nga si nghena.
guide.start.2: Tshikelela Nghena ehenhla, kutani u tirhisa vuxokoxoko bya akhawunti ya xikombiso leyi u nyikiweke yona.
guide.start.3: Hlawula purasi. Dashboard ya purasi rero yi ta pfuleka.
guide.start.4: Tshikelela nguva leswaku u vona swilo hinkwako swa ximilana xexo ensin'wini yoleyo.
guide.start.5: Tirhisa bokisi ra ririmi ehenhla ka tluka rin’wana ni rin’wana ku cinca ririmi. App yi ta tsundzuka leswi u swi hlawuleke loko u vuya.
guide.home.title: Tluka ro sungula
guide.home.p1: Tluka ro sungula ri komba mepe wa muganga lowu pendiweke hi ku ya hi ku hisa loku misava yi ku kumeke eka nguva leyi. Ri tlhela ri komba maxelo ya sweswi ni ya masiku lama taka, misava ya purasi ra xikombiso, switsotswana leswi voniweke ekusuhi sweswinyana ni ntshovelo wa xiringaniso wa muganga. A swi lavi leswaku u nghena leswaku u swi vona.
guide.dashboard.title: Dashboard ya purasi
guide.dashboard.intro: Dashboard yi komba purasi rin’we. Lawa i swiphemu swa yona ku sukela ehenhla ku ya ehansi ka tluka. Bokisi ra purasi leri nga ehenhla ri ku pfumelela ku ya eka purasi rin’wana.
guide.dashboard.summary.label: Nkatsakanyo wa purasi
guide.dashboard.summary: Nhlayo ya masimu ni tihekitara ta purasi, tinguva leti fambaka ni swimilana leswi lungheke.
guide.dashboard.alerts.label: Swi lava ku langutiwa
guide.dashboard.alerts: Swilemukiso swo koma, ku fana ni xirhami kumbe ku hisa loku vhumbhiweke, ximilana lexi lungheke, nguva leyi nga sungulangiki hi nkarhi kumbe switsotswana leswi voniweke ekusuhi ni nsimu. Xilemukiso xin’wana ni xin’wana xi vula lexi xi vangeke.
guide.dashboard.conditions.label: Xiyimo xa purasi
guide.dashboard.conditions: Maxelo ya namuntlha, vuprofeta bya maxelo, misava ni switsotswana swa le kusuhi ni purasi leri.
guide.dashboard.progress.label: Ku famba ka nguva
guide.dashboard.progress: Khadi ra ximilana xin’wana ni xin’wana leri kombaka ku hisa loku xi ku hlengeleteke. U nga ringanisa masimu hi tlhelo ni tlhelo, u tlhela u dawuniloda nxaxamelo wu va fayili ya spreadsheet (CSV).
guide.dashboard.fields.label: Masimu
guide.dashboard.fields: Masimu hinkwako ya purasi ni vukulu bya wona, misava ya wona ni swimilana swa wona.
guide.dashboard.search.label: Lava tirhekhodo
guide.dashboard.search: Tsala leswi u swi lavaka hi marito ya ntolovelo, ku fana ni tinsuna eka koroni. Yi kuma leswi voniweke ni leswi endliweke leswi vulaka mhaka yin’we, hambiloko ku tirhisiwe marito man’wana.
guide.dashboard.recommendations.label: Swiringanyeto
guide.dashboard.recommendations: Ntirho lowu ringanyetiweke ensin'wini, ku fana ni ku fafazela kumbe ku chela manyoro. U nga pfumela kumbe u ala xin’wana ni xin’wana, kutani u xi fungha xi herile loko ntirhweni wu hetiwile.
guide.dashboard.activity.label: Leswi swa ha ku endliwaka
guide.dashboard.activity: Nxaxamelo wa nkarhi lowu ximilana xin’wana ni xin’wana xi yeke eka xiyimo lexintshwa.
guide.season.title: Tluka ra nguva
guide.season.intro: Nguva i ximilana xin’we ensin'wini yin’we hi lembe rin’we. Tluka ra yona ri ni swilo hinkwako leswi khumbaka yona.
guide.season.top.label: Ehenhla ka tluka
guide.season.top: Ximilana, nsimu, siku ro byala, siku leri ntshovelo wu languteriweke ha rona ni ntsengo wa ntshovelo loko u wu nghenisile.
guide.season.pipeline.label: Ku landzelelana ka swiyimo
guide.season.pipeline: Swiyimo swa tsevu, laha xa sweswi xi funghiweke. Tshikelela Kambela sweswi leswaku u hatla u vona loko ximilana xi fanele xi ya eka xiyimo lexi landzelaka.
guide.season.readiness.label: Ku lunghekela xiboho
guide.season.readiness: Nxaxamelo wa leswi app yi swi lavaka yi nga si yisa ximilana eka xiyimo lexi landzelaka, ku fana ni siku ro byala ni rungula ra maxelo leri eneleke. Xin’wana ni xin’wana xi vula leswaku Swi pasile, Xilemukiso kumbe Swi siveriwile. Lexi siveriweke xi vula leswi kayivelaka.
guide.season.evidence.label: Vumbhoni
guide.season.evidence: Tirhekhodo leti app yi ti tirhiseke ku endla swiboho, leswaku u kota ku ti kambela.
guide.season.propose.label: Ringanyeta ntirhwana
guide.season.propose: Ringanyeta ntirhwana wa nsimu leyi, u namarheta vumbhoni bya nguva. Wu rindza wu ri mpfapfarhuto ku kondza munhu a wu pfumela eka dashboard.
guide.season.gdd.label: Growing degree days
guide.season.gdd: Chati ya tiyuniti ta ku hisa leti hlengeletanaka ku sukela eku byariweni, ni layini ya ntsengo lowu ximilana xi wu lavaka.
guide.season.whatIf.label: Loko swi nga va tano?
guide.season.whatIf: Ringeta siku ro byala ra ha ri na nkarhi kumbe leri hlweleke, kumbe nguva yo kufumela kumbe yo titimela, kutani u vona ndlela leyi tiyuniti ta ku hisa ti nga cincaka ha yona. A ku na lexi hlayisiwaka.
guide.season.summary.label: Nkatsakanyo wa nguva
guide.season.summary: Nkatsakanyo wo koma wa tirhekhodo ta nguva lowu tsariweke hi AI. Wu tirhise ku ku pfuna, kutani u kambela tirhekhodo loko ku ri ni leswi nga langutekiki kahle.
guide.season.notes.label: Tinotsi ta nguva
guide.season.notes: Tinotsi ta nguva leti nga ni masiku. U nga ti engetela, u ti cinca, u ti sula, u tlhela u vuyisa muxaka wa khale wa notsi.
guide.season.files.label: Xifaniso xa nsimu ni xiviko xa xikambelo xa misava
guide.season.files: Layicha xifaniso xa nsimu ni PDF ya xikambelo xa misava leyi humaka elabhoratori.
guide.season.log.label: Rhekhodo ya nsimu
guide.season.log: Leswi u swi voneke ensin'wini ni leswi u swi endleke eka yona, ku fana ni ku fafazela hi murhi wo karhi ni mpimo wa wona.
guide.season.history.label: Matimu ya ku cinca
guide.season.history: Ku cinca kun’wana ni kun’wana loku hlayisiweke eka nguva leyi, ni siku ra kona.
guide.season.benchmark.label: Mpimo wa muganga
guide.season.benchmark: Ntshovelo wa xiringaniso wa muganga lowu humaka eka tinhlayo ta mani na mani. Wu kona leswaku u ringanisa, naswona a hi ntshovelo wa nsimu ya wena.
guide.season.pests.label: Swiviko swa switsotswana swa muganga
guide.season.pests: Switsotswana leswi vikiweke ekusuhi ni nsimu eka GBIF, database ya mani na mani ya leswi voniweke. Tshikelela Teka swiviko leswaku u kuma leswintshwa.
guide.sources.title: Laha tinomboro ti humaka kona
guide.sources.weather: Maxelo ma huma eka Open-Meteo, ya namuntlha, vuprofeta ni masiku lama hundzeke.
guide.sources.soil: Rungula ra misava ri huma eka SoilGrids, mepe wa misava wa misava hinkwaro.
guide.sources.pests: Swiviko swa switsotswana swi huma eka GBIF, database ya mani na mani ya leswi voniweke.
guide.sources.yields: Ntshovelo wa muganga wu huma eka USDA FAS, HarvestStat-Africa ni World Bank.
guide.sources.you: Leswin'wana hinkwako, ku fana ni tinotsi, leswi endliweke ensin'wini ni ntshovelo wa wena, swi nghenisiwe hi wena kumbe ntlawa wa wena.
guide.limits.title: Leswi yi nga kotiki ku swi endla
guide.limits.model: Tiyuniti ta ku hisa leti ximilana xin’wana ni xin’wana xi ti lavaka i mimpimo ya hina naswona a ti si ringiwa ensin'wini. Ti tirhise ku ku kongomisa, kambe tshemba leswi u swi vonaka ensin'wini ya wena.
guide.limits.maturity: Ku vupfa hi ku hisa swi vula leswaku maxelo ma komba leswaku xibyariwa xi fanele xi lunghekile. Hi wena ntsena u tivaka loko xi lunghekile hakunene.
guide.limits.translation: Vuhundzuluxeri byi tsariwe hi AI. Byi fanele byi olova ku byi twisisa, kambe a byi kambiwanga hinkwabyo hi munhu loyi a tivaka ririmi rero kahle.
guide.limits.demo: Demo yi pfulekele vanhu hinkwavu, kutani u nga nghenisi vuxokoxoko bya xihundla.
